segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the exfoliator effectively clears pores but can burn or irritate if left on too long, while the lightweight moisturizer gives a matte finish without added shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the exfoliator can leave skin soft but risks irritation the next day without a follow-up moisturizer, and the lightweight moisturizer is seen by some as insufficiently hydrating for very dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the moisturizer balances oily T-zones and dry patches without feeling heavy or causing oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say the exfoliator and cleanser are gentle with no irritation or reaction, but one review explicitly warns the exfoliator is not recommended for sensitive skin and another reports burning within minutes.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin reports the exfoliator gave a noticeable glow without drying out the skin and suggests it would suit younger skin too.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing normal-to-dry skin found the moisturizer had a tightening, mask-like sensation and felt insufficiently moisturizing for her skin type.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports a noticeable glow and effective, non-drying exfoliation; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the moisturizer and exfoliator leave skin soft and hydrated without heaviness, though a few note the moisturizer felt insufficiently moisturizing or caused mild dryness after use, especially for drier skin types.
concerns.redness: Reviewers largely report no redness or irritation from the cleanser, exfoliator, or moisturizer; one reviewer specifically notes the moisturizer helped reduce facial redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers note the exfoliator can cause irritation or a tight, uncomfortable feeling if left on too long or not followed by moisturizer, though most describe no barrier disruption when used as directed.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the exfoliator and cleanser help clear blackheads and visibly reduce clogged pores.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report fewer breakouts and cleared acne within days of using the exfoliator or cleanser; no reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oilier skin report the products, especially the moisturizer and cleanser, control excess oil and leave a matte, non-greasy finish.

aspects.libelle: Burning or stinging if left on too long

extraits.texte: Tricoci sent me this free sample of the lightweight moisturizer through the BzzAgent sampling program and I've spent a week or so testing it out. I saw it had a ton of good reviews so I was shocked that I didn't immediately love it. I noticed it had a tightening sensation on my skin, similar to putting a mask on when it starts drying, and I didn't love that feeling. I did see a plump initially, but because it's lightweight it does get absorbed pretty quickly I didn't feel like it was very moisturizing for me. I have pretty normal skin and leaning toward the dry side right now because of the weather, so I think this plays a huge factor. I noticed positive reviews for those with oily skin so maybe that's who the target audience is here. On a positive note, the packaging was really nice and I really appreciated being able to pump once or twice for a measured amount without having to touch the rest of the moisturizer. Bummed that this one wasn't for me.

I received this free in exchange for my honest review. I have really oily skin and somewhat big pores so I was really excited to try this pore refiner. You apply a thick layer all over the skin and then massage in softly, this has really tiny exfoliating particles that can irritate your skin if you're too rough. For oily skin, it says to leave on for up to 15 minutes, there is no way I would ever leave it on that long, my face started burning at the 3 minute mark, which is the time to leave on for dry skin, but I had to get this off my face immediately. I don't have sensitive skin so I was surprised this burned on my face so much, it didn't irritate anything or cause any skin reaction, and the burning may be whats supposed to happen but I couldn't handle it. My skin did look extremely smooth right after and my pores were definitely cleaned out. This is definitely a product you need to use caution with but it does work and I'll continue to use, just sparingly.

extraits.titre: Exfoliating easy and on a budget
extraits.texte: I have super dry skin so I use this a few times a week to cleanse away dry flakey skin. The biggest thing I have learned in my skin journey is that consistency and the right products for your skin type are more important than expensive or viral products

Heads up!! Tricoci Refine Exfoliator is not recommended for use on sensitive skin. This product makes my face feel invigorating and fresh. Tricoci Refine Exfoliator is a clay- based gentle Exfoliator that smooths skin and detoxifies pores. The Kaolin clay and AHAs/BHAs absorb excess oil, clarify skin tone all while unclogging pores. Skin is polished with biodegradable jojoba esters without causing irritation. It is suitable for use 2-3 times a week. It is frangrance-free, free of parabens, sulfates, phthalates, dyes and ethanol alcohol, reducing the risk of irritation. I have noticed that serums and moisturizers absorb much better after Tricoci Refine Exfoliator, improving overall skincare efficacy. When developing this product, professionals sought input from licensed estheticians, ensuring a balance of effectiveness and skin safety. I applied a thin layer on my clean, dry skin, left it on 5-10 minutes, massaged my face with wet fingertips, activating the polishing beads. I rinse thoroughly and then apply my serums and moisturizers.

extraits.titre: I will be getting another bottle once I run out!
extraits.texte: Tricoci kindly gifted me this Refine Exfoliator so I could try it out, and I'm genuinely impressed. I've used similar products before, but this one gave me a noticeable glow that others haven't. It exfoliates beautifully without drying out my skin, which is a huge plus. I also love that you only need to use it a few times a week rather than daily. I have mature skin, and it worked wonderfully for me, but I can see it being gentle enough for younger skin as well. Once I finish this bottle, I'll definitely be purchasing another. I highly recommend giving it a try.

I received this product for free for my honest review. I have sensitive, dry skin yet clogged pores. I'm always looking for gentle cleansers that can help me have a clean skin and most importantly don't irritate. I've used it enough time to see that it works! Very grateful I got a chance to try this cleanser and I would recommend it to anyone!

I've been using this exfoliator 3 nights a week for a couple weeks now and I love it! I have dry facial skin and an oily forehead and after using my whole face feels clean and refreshed. I'm not crazy about the scent but it's worth it! I received a free product in exchange for an honest review.
